_meta.notes: FILENAME MISLEADS: 'Winder_M_12Mayor_Amended_Final_Redacted.pdf' says Mayor, but the document is JAMES M WINDER, SHERIFF (Democratic) — the manifest's candidate/office labels are the correct ones, the filename is not. This is NOT the handwritten paper form: it is a printout from the clerk's online disclosure system ('summary_printer.cfm?ID=931', printed 3/1/2013, received MAR 01 2013), headed 'Winder, James M - 2012 Summary Report (Year End)', Org Type 'Personal Campaign Committee', Report '2012 Summary Report (Year End) (Amended)'. PDF page 1 is a typed cover letter from the filer listing in-kind corrections that the online tool could not accept ('Financial Disclosure End-of-Year 2012, Amendment 1'); the report proper starts on PDF page 2. The summary table has FOUR money columns — 'Total this Period' / 'YTD' / and a separate pair for OTHER CAMPAIGN ACCOUNTS (both $0.00 on Lines 1 and 2). Column A was taken from 'Total this Period' and Column B from 'YTD'; the Other-Campaign-Accounts columns are deliberately not recorded. There is no checkbox block and no signature — is_amendment 'Yes' comes from the printed '(Amended)' on the report line, and the report date is the system print date.

contributions.detail: exact (29436.27 = 29,436.27). 148 rows across PDF p3-p6 sum exactly to the table's own printed 'Total Contributions $29,436.27' at the foot of PDF p6.

expenditures.detail: exact (18370.57 = 18,370.57). 118 rows across PDF p6-p9 sum exactly to the printed 'Total Expenditures $18,370.57' on PDF p9.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: This document is not the pre-printed Schedule A/B grid - it is the clerk system's own printed report (footer http://slcintranet/financialDisclosure/clerk/summary_printer.cfm?ID=931, 3/1/2013) and it prints NO per-page subtotals, so no page-subtotal gate exists. The two schedule totals it does print BOTH gate exactly: contributions rows 29,436.27 = printed 29,436.27; expenditure rows 18,370.57 = printed 18,370.57.
itemized.escalation_note: none needed - the document is a clean laser print, every figure legible at the 200 dpi base read, and both schedule totals closed to the cent on the first pass.
itemized.notes: LABEL CONTRADICTION (already known to the repo, re-confirmed here): the filename says '12Mayor' but every page is headed 'Winder, James M - 2012 Summary Report (Year End)' and the office is SHERIFF. Transcribed from the form. FORM VARIANT: this is NOT the pre-printed Schedule A/B grid; it is the clerk's summary_printer report, whose contribution table is Date Received | Contributor Name | Occupation | Employer | Type | Amount | In-Kind?. There is NO mailing-address column anywhere in the document, so donor_city/donor_state are blank because the field does not exist - this is different from the county redacting an address block, and different from a filer leaving it empty. Occupation/Employer are present but are not fields in this record's schema; the Type value (Individual/Organization) is preserved in each row note. MANY ROWS ARE MARKED 'AMENDMENT' in the date cell (this is the Amended Final) - 33 contribution rows and 25 expenditure rows; the marker is recorded in the row note and the printed date is used as-is. On PDF p5 the word 'AMENDMENT' appears alone at the top of the table as the wrapped second line of the LAST row of p4 (10/10/2012 511 Impact Eyeware $75.00) - it is not a separate row. PDF p9 also prints 'No Contributions Received from other Campaign Accounts reported for this period' and 'No Expenditures of other Campaign Accounts reported for this period' - honest printed zeros for the other-accounts schedules. GEOMETRY IS OMITTED on every row of this filing: the table is a ruled grid and rule-line detection would not resolve to exactly one cell per transcribed row on 4 of the 7 table pages (scan-density variation drops individual rules), so per the brief a pointer that might be off by a row was withheld rather than guessed. Row identity is instead guaranteed by both schedule totals closing to the cent.
